svg.text: Terms added tip to tail: X[1] and X[3] of the teaching signal (N = 8)
k = 1: the terms point the same way, so they reinforce
X[1] = 4: from the start of the chain to its end
k = 3: the terms point in all directions, so they cancel
X[3] = 0: the chain ends at its start (purple ring)
Ink arrow: a term from a positive sample.
Red arrow: a term from a negative sample.
A red arrow points opposite to its probe arrow.
x[2] = x[6] = 0, so those terms add nothing.
Arrow n = 4 is drawn a little above the axis,
so that it does not hide arrow n = 0.
The sample sets the length and sign.
